title: How to Position Your Side Mirrors Properly (Part 2)
hook: Part 2! Eliminate your dangerous blind spots.

script.narration: Part 2! Eliminate your dangerous blind spots.
script.visual_search: driver adjusting side mirror from inside car

script.narration: First, lean your head until it almost touches the driver side window. Second, adjust your left mirror outward until you barely see the side of your car. Third, repeat on the passenger side by leaning toward the center console.
script.visual_search: driver looking at side mirror outside view

script.narration: Now cars disappear from your rearview and instantly appear in your side mirrors. Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this? Comment yes or no, because
